transcript: Canonical serialization rule: take the proposal artifact exactly as given, serialize it as JSON with sorted keys and no whitespace, persist the exact bytes as proposal_canon.json, then compute hProposal = SHA-256(proposal_canon.json). In this run, the seed is derived as seedHex = SHA-256(hProposal + salt) (salt = 7f96eafc5fccf3cebbe6a79f5ee1d7c8cef4f7dc8d2544cf13e7dea66171784f). A third party can re-derive by hashing the same proposal_canon.json to reproduce hProposal, concatenating it with the same salt, and hashing again to reproduce seedHex.
